# Luit Studio

> Luit Studio is a design and build studio based in Guwahati, Assam, India, co-founded by Abhishek Kumar Prasad and Prince Das. The studio works with clients across Guwahati, Assam, Northeast India, and the rest of India, as well as internationally.

Luit Studio is a small, closely-involved team — clients work directly with the people doing the work, not through account managers or layers of handoffs.

## Services

- Web and App Development — fast, modern websites and web apps
- AI Automation — workflows and tools that cut out repetitive work
- UI/UX Design — interfaces that are clear to use and easy to trust
- Graphic Design — logos, layouts, and visual identity systems
- Digital Marketing — campaigns and positioning built around real numbers
- Social Media Handling — consistent posting, community replies, and a real voice
- Video Editing — documentaries, YouTube videos, reels, and short films
- Motion Graphics — animated graphics and titles
